headline: 10 Dhaka flights cancelled after Houthi strike on Riyadh airport
summary: Over 3,000 passengers are stranded as flights to and from King Khalid International Airport are suspended following an attack.
details: A Houthi rebel strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, has led to the cancellation of 10 flights on the Dhaka-Riyadh-Dhaka route on Monday, October 12.
Two Biman Bangladesh Airlines flights have been suspended until further notice, while Saudi Airlines cancelled four flights and Riyadh Air cancelled two.
One US-Bangla Airlines flight was unable to land in Riyadh and was forced to divert to another location before returning to Dhaka with a delay.
The attack resulted in casualties, with reports indicating two Bangladeshis were killed and 24 others injured in the strike.
Airlines have requested passengers not to go to the airport for now and to contact call centers or travel agents for rescheduling and updates.
The incident caused panic at the airport, with people rushing to save their lives following the sudden explosions.
caption:
10 flights cancelled, 3,000+ passengers stranded. A Houthi strike on Riyadh airport has left Bangladeshis dead and injured.

A Houthi rebel strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, has led to the cancellation of 10 flights on the Dhaka-Riyadh-Dhaka route on Monday, October 12.

Two Biman Bangladesh Airlines flights have been suspended until further notice, while Saudi Airlines cancelled four flights and Riyadh Air cancelled two.

One US-Bangla Airlines flight was unable to land in Riyadh and was forced to divert to another location before returning to Dhaka with a delay.

The attack resulted in casualties, with reports indicating two Bangladeshis were killed and 24 others injured in the strike.

Airlines have requested passengers not to go to the airport for now and to contact call centers or travel agents for rescheduling and updates.

The incident caused panic at the airport, with people rushing to save their lives following the sudden explosions.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com, The Daily Star

headline_marked: Attack on [[GM Kader's house in Uttara]]
headline: Attack on GM Kader's house in Uttara
summary: A group of people marched to the Jatiya Party chairman's residence and threw bricks, breaking windows.
details: A group of people attacked and vandalized the residence of Jatiya Party (JP) Chairman GM Kader in Uttara, Dhaka, on Monday morning around 11:30 AM.
Witnesses report that a crowd marched to the house, chanting slogans before throwing bricks and stones at the building.
The attack resulted in several broken window panes, although the attackers did not manage to enter the house.
Uttara Division Deputy Commissioner of Police Rezaul Karim confirmed the incident to Prothom Alo.
Police arrived at the scene shortly after receiving the report, but the attackers had already fled the area.
Authorities are currently working to identify the perpetrators of the attack.
